title: Aureline M5 worktree cleanup preview
description: Canonical per-domain descriptor for the cleanup preview that safely removes one worktree-manager-row working context. Cleanup never feels like `rm -rf and hope`: before any removal this object names the worktree status (active, orphaned, abandoned, or cleanup-ready), the affected running work it must preserve (running tasks, open editors, and the uncommitted-change scope), the recovery posture (reflog / checkpoint recovery and export-safe evidence), the removing actor (an explicit user command, a background agent, or broad automation), and the resolved cleanup disposition — so an orphaned worktree or stale stack member stays blocked from removal for background agents and broad automation unless the user explicitly previews and confirms the cleanup, and nothing is deleted from ambient branch state. Names the object class, its change-orchestration association, the worktree status, the cleanup disposition, the removing actor, the recovery posture, and whether the affected work and export-safe evidence are previewed — so no worktree is removed without previewing running tasks, open editors, uncommitted changes, and recovery checkpoints, and no member is silently reordered, collapsed, or retargeted. Downstream the worktree-manager row, patch-stack / queue, provider-landing, and support / export packets point at this schema instead of restating removal-safety behavior by hand. Raw paths, raw provider payloads, secret values, and private endpoints never cross this boundary.
